result.stdout:
BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.

Usage: bidilint <folder> [--base en] [--format text|json] [--strict]

  <folder>     Folder holding locale files: JSON named by culture (en.json, ar.json, ...)
               and/or .resx resources (Strings.resx is the base, Strings.ar.resx Arabic, ...).
  --base       Base culture every other file is compared against (default: en).
  --format     text (default) or json, for tooling.
  --strict     Exit 4 when any error is found (built for CI gates).
